candidate: Google Cloud Compute Engine e2-micro conditional free tier

design_steps.requirement: Confirm eligibility, exact region, e2-micro hours, eligible disk/egress and billing account terms; do not infer zero costs from a Free Tier label.
Calculate full hypothetical bill including disk, snapshot, IPv4, network and zone; budget alerts alone are not a hard spending cap. Verify if any spend cap applies to the selected services.
Review VPC-layer explicit deny for IPv4 and IPv6 and prevent more-specific allow bypass; default implied egress allow is not acceptable.
Use least privilege; no privileged default VM service account or ambient metadata credentials exposed to future workload.
Host-enforced CPU/memory/process/wall/disk limits for child and descendants; VM size alone does not enforce per-process limits.
Run only separately reviewed fixed non-model outbound-denial and failure-mode probes against an authorized controlled endpoint; validate policy logs as well as denied connection.
Review immutable input/commit hashes and bounded artifact output; no experimental model data yet.
Independent security/scientific signoff and Marcus's separate explicit permission for exact inference/training workload.

threat_notes: Cloud VM default egress is allowed unless overridden, including possible IPv6 paths.
A billing alert does not automatically stop spending.
Spend caps may be eligible-service-specific; no universal zero-cost cap is assumed.
Public PR workflows should not control cloud VM privileged administration.
No VM, firewall or billing changes are requested in this stage.
success_criterion: Only a future independently audited, externally enforced no-egress and fully budgeted host may proceed to separate approval; current NO_GO remains.
